## What Improved

### Stable post-wave period
The v0.3.60–62 changes shipped two weeks ago continue to hold with no reported regressions. The TTY prompt hardening in `lib/config.sh`, `lib/cleanup.sh`, and `lib/reinstall.sh` (DEV-149, B33-001–005) covers the critical `curl | bash` install path. Shellcheck suppressions in `lib/` remain at 2 (both SC2162, justified). No `eval` usage detected in mainline scripts.

### Platform count (codex) — ambiguity resolved
`agtoosa.sh` line 658 shows `7|codex|opencode|other` grouped under the same option. `codex` is an alias for `opencode`, not a distinct platform. `all_plats` in `lib/cleanup.sh` (line 187) contains 7 entries: `cursor windsurf claude gemini copilot vscode opencode`. **Platform count is confirmed at 7.** ADR-001 item 4 evaluation trigger (8th platform) has not been met. This closes the ambiguity flagged in the Aug 14 report.

### Migration wizard — feature already shipped
Yesterday's report stated "no implementation exists in the codebase" for the ADR-004 item 5 migration wizard. This was incorrect. `lib/migrate.sh` (257 lines) implements the MAJOR-version migration wizard as DEV-091, shipped in v0.3.18 (2026-07-12). The file includes `is_major_migration()`, `compute_migration_plan()`, `emit_migration_plan_human()`, `confirm_major_migration()`, `run_major_migration()`, and `write_rollback_manifest()`. Master-Plan confirms "🏁 Shipped — v0.3.18" with full archived quartet (`spec-DEV-091.md`, `review-DEV-091.md`, `evidence-DEV-091.md`).

The gap is tracking hygiene: ADR-004 item 5 still shows `[ ]` unchecked and TODOS.md lists two stale entries about it.
